parameters.name: ChanelType
parameters.description:
The alert notification method. Valid values:

<props="china">- SMS: text message.</props>

<props="china">- AliIM: TradeManager.</props>

- Mail: email.

- DingWebHook: DingTalk chatbot.

parameters.name: ChanelValue
parameters.description:
The value of the alert notification method.

> This parameter is required only when `ChanelType` is set to `Mail`.

parameters.name: ContactName
parameters.description: The name of the alert contact.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The current page number.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: 100.
